excerpt: Formula 1® partnered with AWS to build the Data Accelerator, using agentic AI on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to transform its MarTech data platform. Learn how F1 cut data source onboarding from up to 8 weeks to about 40 minutes, automated schema evolution, and gained end-to-end observability across its fan-engagement data estate.
